backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing authentication, user profiles, product management, orders, recharge orders, bills, and barcode-based product lookup with role-based access control (admin/user) and blob storage integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented barcode scanning capabilities including QuaggaJS integration, auto-focus, flash toggle, instant product fetch, continuous scanning mode, and audio feedback with high confidence test coverage.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend React components and pages including barcode scanner, billing page, admin dashboard, product management, cart, checkout flow, and mobile-optimized UI with touch targets and authentication guards.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color palette defining light and dark theme variables for a warm earthy design system with sidebar, chart, and component color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with PWA meta tags, camera usage description for barcode scanning, manifest link, apple-touch-icon configuration, and theme color for Maa Bhawani General Store app.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app name, icons (192x192, 512x512, 180x180), standalone display mode, portrait orientation, and theme colors for installable web app experience.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first for API calls, with install/activate lifecycle management and offline fallback support.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router configuration defining routes for home, checkout, order confirmation, store details, admin dashboard, billing page, and admin settings with shared Layout wrapper.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Protects admin routes by checking authentication status via Internet Identity and provides a login dialog for admin credentials with principal copying and session management.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: Form component for adding new products with fields for name, category, price, barcode, and image upload with progress tracking and duplicate barcode validation.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays a table of all products with images and provides delete functionality with confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/BarcodeScanner.t: Camera-based barcode scanner using Quagga2 library loaded from CDN, with flash toggle, beep sound on scan, and cooldown to prevent duplicate scans.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Displays searchable table of all generated bills with view, print, and CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: Renders a printable bill template with shop details, customer info, itemized list, and total amount formatted for 80mm thermal printers.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Fixed floating button in bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to the shop number.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: A slide-out drawer component that displays shopping cart items with quantities, prices, and subtotal, supporting swipe gestures to close and navigation to checkout. Includes functionality to clear the cart and handles empty cart states.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: A horizontal scrollable filter component that displays category buttons, highlighting the selected category and allowing users to filter products by category.
An informational alert component that displays the store's delivery policy: free delivery within 1km and ₹20 per km beyond that distance.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: A React error boundary class component that catches rendering errors, displays error details with stack traces, and provides options to retry or navigate home.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A footer component displaying store information, contact details with phone and Google Maps links, delivery info, and attribution to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: A sticky header component with store branding, navigation links, cart icon with item count badge, and login/logout functionality using Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: A layout wrapper component that provides consistent page structure with header, main content area, footer, and a call-us button across all pages.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: A form component for mobile recharge orders with fields for mobile number, operator selection, and amount, validating input and submitting recharge requests for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: A card component displaying payment amount and a QR code image with step-by-step UPI payment instructions for customers to complete their purchase.
frontend/src/components/PhoneNumberSetup: An empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: A product card component displaying product image, name, category badge, and price with an add-to-cart button that requires authentication and shows loading states.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Displays a filterable grid of products with category filtering, loading skeletons, and empty state handling using ProductCard components.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Manages the backend actor instance with authentication, creating anonymous or authenticated actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality, identity management, and status tracking through React context and AuthClient integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including products, cart, orders, recharge orders, bills, authentication, and shop settings with proper cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color variables for light/dark themes using a warm earthy palette, touch-friendly utilities, and print styles for bill templates.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard displaying statistics cards, tabs for managing products/orders/recharges/bills, with navigation to billing and settings pages.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page for configuring shop slogan with live preview using a mock bill template and save functionality.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: Admin-only billing page that allows scanning or manually entering product barcodes to build a bill, adjust quantities, and generate/print bills with customer details.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page where authenticated users enter delivery details (name, phone, address, distance), calculate total with delivery fees, and place orders.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page displaying a store banner image, mobile recharge section, and a product grid for browsing groceries.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page showing order ID, payment QR code, next steps instructions, and action buttons to continue shopping or call the store.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Store information page displaying contact details, location map, delivery policy, store hours, and available services with call-to-action buttons.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH, container settings, extended theme properties, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for an admin billing application with barcode scanning functionality. Documents existing features (barcode scanning with QuaggaJS/ZXing, auto-focus, flash toggle, continuous scanning, audio feedback, error handling) and a known issue where the current barcode scanner fails to recognize barcodes despite opening the camera.
